notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Sections were omitted in the general revision of title VII of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965, Pub. L. 89–10, title VII, as added Pub. L. 93–380, title I, § 105(a)(1), Aug. 21, 1974, 88 Stat. 511, by Pub. L. 95–561, title VII, § 701, Nov. 1, 1978, 92 Stat. 2268. Section 880b–12, Pub. L. 89–10, title VII, § 741, as added Pub. L. 93–380, title I, § 105(a)(1), Aug. 21, 1974, 88 Stat. 511, provided for the administration of the research and demonstration projects program. Section 880b–13, Pub. L. 89–10, title VII, § 742, as added Pub. L. 93–380, title I, § 105(a)(1), Aug. 21, 1974, 88 Stat. 511; amended Pub. L. 94–482, title V, § 501(d)(3), Oct. 12, 1976, 90 Stat. 2237, related to research and demonstration projects.
